title: Enable todo_write, Subagents, and Research/Questioning Tools for cvh-dev and Enforce Tactical Planning
commitMessage: feat(agent): enable todo_write, subagents, and research tools for cvh-dev
author: agent-developer (tauri-rust-engineer)
summary: Expanded CVH_DEV_TOOLS to 13 tools (added todo_write, subagent, subagent_bg, collect_subagent, question, web_fetch) to eliminate silent Tool Policy Matrix bypass; updated BUILTIN_CVH_DEV_PROMPT process to mandate calling todo_write on Turn 1 or 2; updated CANONICAL_TOOLS and DEFAULT_CVH_DEV_PERSONA_MD frontmatter; updated Section 2.16 in AGENTS.md; and verified with test_cvh_dev_tools_gating_comprehensive.

rootCauses.cause: Silent Tool Policy Matrix Bypass via Hardcoded CVH_DEV_TOOLS
rootCauses.detail: In src-tauri/src/agent.rs, CVH_DEV_TOOLS hardcoded only 7 tools. Even when todo_write or subagents were enabled in tool-policy.json, active_tools.retain and execute_tool runtime gates rejected them with PermissionDenied.
rootCauses.resolution: Expanded CVH_DEV_TOOLS to 13 configuration, research, delegation, and planning tools while keeping task card manipulation and pipeline progression strictly forbidden.

rootCauses.detail: BUILTIN_CVH_DEV_PROMPT lacked an explicit instruction to publish a tactical step-by-step checklist upon startup.
rootCauses.resolution: Updated BUILTIN_CVH_DEV_PROMPT under Process to mandate calling todo_write on Turn 1 or Turn 2.

rootCauses.detail: CANONICAL_TOOLS in config.rs omitted subagent_bg, collect_subagent, and question, causing sync_persona_frontmatter_tools to drop them during policy saves.
rootCauses.resolution: Added subagent_bg, collect_subagent, and question to CANONICAL_TOOLS and DEFAULT_CVH_DEV_PERSONA_MD frontmatter.
